newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Mostly up on tight supplies.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Mostly up on tight supplies.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly higher on Thursday in the spot position due to tight supplies, several dealers said.
"We have a supply problem in the interior. Some flour mills in Kansas and Oklahoma are losing run time," a dealer said.
Spot millfeed prices for the Kansas/Oklahoma interior rose $3 a ton to bid at $108 and offer at $112.
October prices were also strong in Chattanooga where one trader said supplies "seemed a little tight."
A Buffalo dealer also said the market was pretty firm. "Feed is being well taken and mills are running a little bit slower than three weeks ago," he said.
In St. Louis, a trader said the market was very quiet.
"We have a decent market but not a great one," he said.
